column1: # Ratchet-down-only: lowering a MAX is routine maintenance; raising ANY value
# requires explicit justification in the PR that edits it.
#   lines <src/FILE|zxfer|TOTAL> MAX -- max wc -l line count
#   functions <src/FILE|zxfer|TOTAL> MAX -- max top-level function definitions
#   callers SYMBOL MAX [ALLOWED_FILES] -- max grep -rnF match lines for the
#     literal SYMBOL across src/ + zxfer; the optional comma-separated
#     ALLOWED_FILES list pins which files may contain matches at all.
# survivors (serialize/decode, prefetch, in-memory property tables) when the
# per-dataset file cache was deleted; the TOTAL row still ratchets down.
